source: 592 Bluff
target: 592 Bluff

source: Kill him and channel his spirit?
target: Interfice eum et spiritum eius dirige?

source: Bard stared at Lumian Lee, masquerading as a Muggle, a chill running down his spine as his hair stood on end.
target: Bard oculos in Lumian Lee fixit, qui se ut Muggle simulabat, gelu per dorsum eius decurrens, dum capilli eius erexerentur.

source: He sensed the unmistakable killing intent emanating from Lumian, causing fear to grip him.
target: Sensit propositum caedis inequivocum a Lumian emanare, quod timorem in eum incitabat.

source: However, a suspicion lingered in Bard’s mind; he believed Lumian was trying to manipulate him, deliberately showcasing his anger and hatred to break his psychological defenses.
target: Tamen, suspicio in mente Bard permanebat; censuit Lumian eum fallere conari, iram et odium suum deliberanter ostendens ad munimenta mentis eius rumpenda.

source: His suspicion arose because spirit channeling wasn’t the optimal solution.
target: Suspicio eius orta est, quia directio spiritus non erat optima solutio.

source: Celestial Worthy possessed a higher level than many evil gods, and the corruption of those evil gods could lead to a failed spirit channeling, what’s more someone with the Celestial Worthy’s bestowment.
target: Celestial Worthy altiorem dignitatem habebat quam multi dei mali, et corruptio horum deorum malorum posset ducere ad directum spiritus infaustum; praeterea, aliquis, qui dono a Celestial Worthy praeditus esset.

source: Recognizing this, Bard’s heart settled.
target: Hoc agnovens, cor Bard consolatum est.

source: As a Swindler, he maintained a terrified expression, stepping back two paces as he looked at Lumian.
target: Ut fraudator, vultum territus tenuit, duo passus recedens dum ad Lumian spectabat.

source: “I’ll spill it all, no lies. You can verify it! Don’t kill me!”
target: “Omnia effundam, sine mendaciis. Potes id comprobāre! Noli me interficere!”

source: Lumian approached him step by step, brandishing a dagger.
target: Lumian eum gradatim appropinquavit, pugionem gerens.

source: Bard turned to Hela, Gandalf, and Franca, pleading in a “panicked” tone,
target: Bard ad Hela, Gandalf, et Francam se convertit, voce pavida obsecro.

source: “He’s lost his mind, and you’re just going to let him be? Spirit channeling isn’t all-powerful!”
target: “Iam mentem amisit; et vobis licet eum derelinquere? Directio spiritus omnipotens non est!”

source: Bard deliberately used “him” as a pronoun, signaling that he knew Lumian wasn’t Muggle, as if urging them not to play along.
target: Bard consulto pronomen “eum” usus est, demonstrans se scire Lumian non esse Muggle, quasi eos admonens ne ludificant.

source: In two steps, Lumian arrived in front of Bard, casting his gaze at the April Fool’s key member, who couldn’t temporarily change his appearance back.
target: Duo passus faciens, Lumian ante Bard pervenit, oculos immitiens in membrum clavem Aprilis Stultorum, qui speciem suam ad tempus redire non poterat.

source: He raised the dagger in his hand.
target: Pugionem in manu levavit.

source: Bard sneered inwardly, growing more convinced that Lumian Lee wouldn’t actually end his life for spirit channeling—at least not yet.
target: Bard intus subsurridens, magisque confidens factus est Lumian Lee vitam suam vere non interficere propter spiritus directum—saltem nondum.

source: If his current actions weren’t an act, Gandalf and Hela would have intervened no matter what. They wouldn’t just stand by!
target: Si actus eius praesens non esset simulatio, Gandalf et Hela intervenissent, quaquo modo; neque simpliciter consisterent!

source: Bard strained his throat and shouted, as if terrorized, “I’ll genuinely cooperate with you! I’ll assist you in locating Loki and his ancient castle! See, I didn’t even use my powers to resist in such a situation!”
target: Bard fauces tensit et clamavit, quasi territus, “Vere tecum cooperabor! Te adiuvabo ut Lokim et antiquum castellum eius invenias! Ecce, virtutes meas ne ad repugnandum in tali re quidem non usus sum!”

source: As Bard shouted, he fixed his gaze on Lumian and the dagger’s tip, attempting to convey evasion and pleading through his eyes. The former conveyed fear, and the latter was a plea for mercy.
target: Dum Bard clamabat, oculos suos in Lumian et apicem pugionis fixabat, conans per oculos evasionem atque obsecrationem exprimere. Primum timorem significabat, et secundum precationem misericordiae.

source: Throughout this process, Bard’s heart was filled with mockery, almost void of panic.
target: Per hunc processum, cor Bard iocositate plenum erat, paene carens pavore.

source: Trying to deceive a Swindler?
target: Conaris fraudatorem fallere?

source: What a ludicrous notion!
target: Quam ridicula sententia!

source: I bet you’ll stop after I count to five!
target: Certus sum te desinere postquam ad quinque numerabo!

source: Five, four, three…
target: Quinque, quattuor, tres…

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: Bard’s vision suddenly turned blood‑red as the dagger thrust into his left eye, piercing through the gap in the eye socket and into his brain.
target: Visio Bard subito in rubro sanguine convertebatur, cum pugio in oculum sinistrum eius peniciebatur, per foramina orbitæ transiens atque in cerebrum eius intrans.

source: Impossible!
target: Impossibile!

source: Absolutely impossible!
target: Absolute impossibile!

source: Is he truly going to kill me?
target: Num vere me interficiet?

source: Intense pain overwhelmed Bard’s mind, prompting him to instinctively raise his right hand and press it against his face.
target: Intensus dolor mentem Bard oppressit, incitans eum instinctu dextram manum levare et contra faciem premere.

source: He fought in the opposite direction, striving to put some distance between himself and the dagger, the source of the agonizing damage.
target: In contrariam partem pugnavit, conatus spatium inter se et pugionis, fontem doloris acerbi creare.

source: Lumian reached out with his left hand, pinning Bard in place and making his struggles futile.
target: Lumian manum sinistram extendit, Bard stabile retinens et eius conatus inanes faciens.

source: Then, Lumian leaned forward slightly and whispered into the ear of the April Fool’s key member.
target: Deinde, Lumian paulum se inclinavit et in aure membri clavi Aprilis Stultorum susurravit.

source: Bard glimpsed Muggle’s beautiful face, her rosy lips moving as she whispered
target: Bard intuefactus est pulchram faciem Muggle, labris rosatis movebant, dum susurrabat.

source: —a whisper filled with satisfaction and mockery, “My godson has gnawed on half of Loki’s arm and knows a lot about him. I believe that knowledge surpasses yours…”
target: —Susurro satisfactione et derisione pleno, “Meus filius adoptivus dimidium bracchii Loki morditus est et multa de eo novit. Credo hanc scientiam tuam superare…”

source: Surpasses mine… If I had known earlier, I would have utilized my powers… Even in the midst of pain and struggle, Bard was momentarily stunned, feeling frustration, despair, and embarrassment.
target: Scientia mea superatur… Si antea scivissem, virtutes meas adhibuissem… Etiam inter dolorem et certamen, Bard paulisper stupefactus est, sentiens frustrationem, desperationem, et pudorem.

source: Soon, these emotions dissipated.
target: Cito, hae animi motus evanuerunt.

source: Lumian gripped the dagger embedded in Bard’s eye socket and twisted it a few times, crushing the frontal lobe.
target: Lumian pugionem, in orbitam oculi Bard immissum, arripuit et aliquoties torquens, lobum frontale conterens.

source: Observing Bard, who had now calmed down, Lumian nodded in satisfaction.
target: Bard, qui iam tranquillus erat, spectans, Lumian cum satisfactione annuit.

source: He withdrew his dagger and earnestly assisted the other party in stemming the bleeding and bandaging the wound, though he skipped the disinfectant.
target: Pugionem recepit et alteri eorum strenue auxiliatus est ut sanguinem cohiberet et vulnus circumligaret, sed purgatorium non adhibuit.

source: Only then did Franca approach and click her tongue.
target: Tunc Franca accessit et linguam strinxit.

source: “I thought you were just scaring him.”
target: “Putabam te eum solum terrere.”

source: That’s why she didn’t intervene. She had watched as Lumian advanced toward Bard, dagger in hand, witnessing Bard’s pleas for mercy.
target: Ideo ea non intervenit. Observaverat quomodo Lumian ad Bard accesserit, pugione in manu, et preces Bardis misericordiae vidisset.

source: She believed Hela and Gandalf had similar expectations.
target: Credebat Hela et Gandalf similes exspectationes habere.

source: When the dagger pierced Bard’s eye socket, Franca was taken aback. It was only then that she realized Lumian was serious!
target: Quando pugio orbitam oculi Bard percussit, Franca obstupefacta est. Tunc tantum intellexit Lumian vero serio agere!

source: No, Lumian didn’t truly intend to kill Bard. Instead, he planned to employ the April Fool’s created prank to deal with him, recreating the original state of I Know Someone.
target: Non, Lumian vere Bard interficere non intendebat. Proinde, consilium habebat uti ioco a April Fool creato ad eum aggrediendum, statum originalem "I Know Someone" recriandi.

source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, Franca asked curiously, “When did you master lobotomy?”
target: Sine Lumiani responsione exspectans, Franca curiosa rogavit, “Quando lobotomiae artem didicisti?”

source: Lumian wiped the blood off the dagger with a white strap and smirked mockingly.
target: Lumian sanguinem de pugione stramine albo delevit et deriso risu subridens.

source: “I learned it from watching the doctor perform surgery on I Know Someone.
target: “Id didici ex conspectu medici qui chirurgiam in "I Know Someone" exercuit.

source: “It’s such a simple procedure. As a Beyonder skilled in action, if I can’t memorize and imitate it after watching it once, it only proves that my brain has been corrupted by the potion.”
target: “Processus tam simplex est. Ut Beyonder in actu peritus, si id, post unam visionem, meminisse atque imitari non possum, id solum demonstrat meum cerebrum ab potione corruptum esse.”

source: Impersonating Muggle, Lumian deliberately spoke in his sister’s voice, as if she were still alive.
target: Muggle imitando, Lumian deliberato in voce sororis suae locutus est, quasi illa adhuc esset viva.

source: Franca looked at Aurore’s face under the hood and listened to her voice.
target: Franca aspexit faciem Aurore sub pallio et vocem eius auscultavit.

source: She wasn’t angered by the mockery.
target: Ea derisio non irritata est.

source: She only muttered, “The surgery isn’t just about inserting and stirring a few times. There are still many key points before and after the procedure. Even during the surgery, if you insert it just a bit deeper, the outcome will be entirely different.”
target: Vociferavit tantum, “Chirurgia non solum consistit in aliquoties inserendo et miscendo. Multa tamen sunt puncta clavis ante ac post processum. Etiam inter ipsam chirurgiam, si paulo altius infunderis, exitus omnino diversus erit.”

source: “So be it. If he really dies, we’ll commence the spirit channeling.”
target: “Sic fiat. Si vere moriatur, directio spiritus incipiet.”

source: Lumian casually poured the remaining truth serum into the mouth of the stunned Bard, who offered no resistance.
target: Lumian relictum serum veritatis in os Bard stupefacti leviter infudit, qui nullam repugnationem ostendit.

source: After completing this task, he added, “Madam Hela mentioned that this place can minimize the influence of evil gods.”
target: Hoc confecto, addidit: “Domina Hela dixit hunc locum influentiam deorum malorum minuere posse.”

source: “It’s only minimal, not zero. Besides, what if the problem lies in his spirit, and he self‑destructs?”
target: “Minima tantum est, non nulla. Praeterea, quid si in spiritu ejus quaestio sit, et ipse se deleat?”

source: Franca instinctively retorted.
target: Franca instinctu respondit.

source: This was why Hela hadn’t directly pulled Bard into a dream to extract his true answers.
target: Idcirco Hela Bard non directe in somnium traxerat ut veras responsiones eius extraheretur.

source: After all, the dream might present scenes that shouldn’t be seen. This was even more dangerous than simple verbal descriptions.
target: Postremo, somnium scaenas ostendere posset, quae non videre debent; hoc etiam gravius erat quam simplices verbales descriptiones.

source: Only then did Gandalf, draped in a linen robe and a hood, sigh softly.
target: Tunc tantum Gandalf, indutus linteis vestibus et pallio, leniter suspiravit.

source: He couldn’t bear to witness Bard’s suffering, but he didn’t discourage the actions taken.
target: Non ferre potuit ut passionem Bard videre, sed actus non deterruit.

source: He wasn’t the one who had been harmed by April Fool’s. He wasn’t in a position to criticize the victim’s family for their extreme actions.
target: Ipse non erat qui ab April Fool’s laesus esset. Non erat in statu ut familiae victimæ propter actiones extremas reprehenderet.

source: Before this operation, Hela had briefed Gandalf on Muggle’s demise and Lumian Lee’s role.
target: Ante hanc operationem, Hela Gandalf de decessu Muggle et munere Lumian Lee breviter certiorem fecit.

source: The president of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society sympathized with the siblings’ plight, but he also blamed himself.
target: Praesidens Societatis Inquisitionis Simiorum Crispis Capillis, cum infortunio fratrum et sororum commotus, et se ipsum culpavit.

source: He believed that the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society had been unrestrained. As president, he bore a heavy responsibility.
target: Credidit Societatem Inquisitionis Simiorum Crispis Capillis non esse moderatam. Ut praesidens, grave officium gerebat.

source: After a moment, Bard, who had undergone a “requiem” and gradually recovered from his pain, started addressing the queries of the people present.
target: Post aliquod momentum, Bard, qui ‘requiem’ subiit et paulatim ex dolore restitutus est, quaestiones praesentium audientium aggredi incipiebat.

source: The first to inquire was Gandalf. He peered down at the Dream Stealer and asked, “How did you come to believe in that Celestial Worthy?”
target: Primum interrogans fuit Gandalf. Ad Somnium Furum intuitus, quaesivit, “Quomodo incipis credere in illum Celestial Worthy?”

source: Gandalf and Hela had already gathered intel on Celestial Worthy from Franca and Lumian, and they deemed it crucial.
target: Gandalf et Hela iam notitias de Celestial Worthy a Franca et Lumiano colligaverant, et id maximopere esse arbitrabantur.

source: Bard responded calmly, “From the beginning. I used to be a cultural relic thief and acquired a batch of ancient items. While studying their history to ascertain their value, I deciphered the meaning of some inscriptions…”
target: Bard tranquille respondit, “Ex initio. Olim fur rerum culturalium reliquiarum eram et seriem antiquitatis rerum acquisivi. Dum historiam eorum ad pretium agnoscendum perscrutabar, quasdam inscriptiones interpretatus sum…”

source: Abruptly, Hela cut Bard’s narration short and said coldly,
target: Subito, Hela narrationem Bardis breviter interemit et frigide dixit,

source: “You don’t have to explain the full meaning. Just mention a few keywords.”
target: “Non oportet totum sensum explanare. Pauca tantum verba clavis commemora.”

source: Bard had no intention of arguing. He remained as docile as a sheep.
target: Bard nullam contendendi intentionem habebat. Mansit mansuetus sicut ovis.

source: “Keywords include: Deception, Fooling, Door of All Doors, Lord of Mysteries…
target: “Verba clavis includunt: Fallacia, Simulatio, Porta Omnium Portarum, Dominus Mysteriorum…

source: As Bard finished speaking, the ancient palace they were in suddenly became misty and unclear.
target: Dum Bard sermonem finivit, antiquum palatium in quo erant subito in nebulam et incertum versa est.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian’s left chest burned again.
target: Simul, pectus sinistrum Lumiani iterum ardebat.

source: In the next moment, the night sky outside the palace darkened even more, and all the mist vanished.
target: Segue momento, caelum nocturnum extra palatium adhuc obscure factum est, et omnis nebula evanuit.

source: “Why did I feel like worms were growing in me just now?” Franca felt a lingering fear.
target: “Cur mihi videtur ut vermes in me nunc tantum crescere?” Franca timorem manentem sensit.

source: Merely a few names, incomplete honorific names, made her inexplicably uneasy.
target: Sola pauca nomina, nomina honorifica imperfecta, eam inexplicabiliter solicam fecerunt.

source: Every inch of her flesh seemed to come alive, about to transform into worms crawling out of her skin.
target: Omnis parcella carnis eius videbatur animari, parata in vermes ex cute ejus conversa esse.

source: One of Bard’s initial plans was to answer Lumian and company’s questions dishonestly and without reservation.
target: Unus ex consiliis primariis Bard erat quaestionibus Lumiani et sociorum mendaciter et sine dubitatione responde.

source: Then, he would take the initiative to reveal all the details regarding Celestial Worthy.
target: Deinde, incepturus erat ut omnia de Celestial Worthy notitia demonstraret.

source: He wanted to see if he could secretly corrupt his enemies and shake the Nation of the Evernight’s concealments to create a “door” to escape.
target: Volebat videre an hostes suos occulte corrumpere posset et occultationes Nationis Perpetuae Noctis concutere ad “portam” ad fugam creandam.

source: “If I could really use this to corrupt Gandalf and Hela, why would they kill me when we’re all Celestial Worthy believers? We would definitely work together to deal with Lumian Lee!”
target: “Si id revera ad corrumpendos Gandalf et Hela uti possem, cur me interficerent, cum omnes in Celestial Worthy credentes simus? Certissime simul agerem ad Lumian Lee tractandum!”

source: Of course, Bard no longer harbored such thoughts. He had obtained an inevitable peace.
target: Certe, Bard talia cogitare iam non habebat. Pacem inevitablem accepit.

source: “Descriptions of high‑level existences often indicate danger. In this world, ignorance might not be a bad thing.” Gandalf sighed and assessed what had just happened.
target: “Descriptiones existentiarum altarum saepe periculum ostendunt. In hoc mundo, ignorantia non omnino mala est.” Gandalf suspiravit et ea quae nuper evenit consideravit.

source: He then inquired about the follow‑up.
target: Deinde de subsequentibus quaesivit.

source: Bard’s expression remained unchanged as he said, “After deciphering the words, I lost consciousness. When I woke up, I had already transmigrated to this world.
target: Vultus Bard immutatus remansit, dicens, “Post verba elucidanda, conscientiam amisi. Cum experrectus essem, iam in hunc mundum transmigraveram.

source: “After adapting to my new body, I instinctively recalled my previous encounters and the words I had deciphered. Then, I saw a thin gray fog emanating from my surroundings and received a revelation from the Celestial Worthy.
target: “Postquam ad novum corpus meum adaptatus sum, instinctu commissi prius congressus et verba quae elucidaveram recolui. Deinde tenuem nebulam griseam ex circumstantibus meis emansam vidi et revelationem a Celestial Worthy accepi.

source: “In other words, you believed in that Celestial Worthy as soon as you transmigrated, before the establishment of the Research Society?” Gandalf probed further.
target: “Alio modo, credidisti in illum Celestial Worthy statim postquam transmigraveras, ante constitutionem Societatis Inquisitionis?” Gandalf ulterius rogavit.

source: “Yes.” Bard’s emotions lacked any fluctuations. “Back then, I thought that if I didn’t choose to submit, believe in Him, or follow Him, I might die on the spot. When that happened, I might not have a chance to transmigrate and revive. Later, I gradually realized His greatness. He could even fool the Nation of the Evernight and prevent our problems from being discovered.”
target: “Ita,” Bard respondit, cuius affectus nullas mutationes ostendebant. “Illo tempore putabam, si non elegissem cedere, in Eum credere, aut Eum sequi, statim moriturus fore. Si ita evenisset, fortasse occasionem non haberem ut transmigrarer et revivissem. Postea, paulatim magnitudinem Eius intellexi. Etiam Nationem Perpetuae Noctis fallere posset, ne problemata nostra detegerentur.”

source: Gandalf pondered for a moment and asked, “How did Loki come to believe in that Celestial Worthy?”
target: Gandalf paulisper meditatus est et rogavit, “Quomodo Loki credere coepit in illum Celestial Worthy?”
